newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire Pacific launches perpetual bond.
newsitem.headline: Swire Pacific launches perpetual bond.

text.p: Swire Pacific has launched a US$300 million perpetual subordinated bond issue, sole bookrunner and lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Wednesday.
The bond has an 8.84 percent coupon payable quarterly and was priced and re-offered at par to yield 191 basis points over the U.S. Treasury bond due November 2026.
The bond is callable at par on its 20th anniversary and annually thereafter.
Details are as follows:
